CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "xpub + derivation paths, not key material":
a verifier derives child public keys from XPUB and KEY_PATH wherever the
curve permits. That permission is asymmetric, PERMANENTLY AND BY DESIGN:

- secp256k1 at a NON-hardened path (e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0") IS derivable
from XPUB via BIP-32 public derivation, so such an entry may omit
PUBLIC_KEY entirely and carry only {XPUB, KEY_PATH, KEY_TYPE, ALGORITHM}.
- ed25519 under SLIP-10 has NO public derivation at all — every ed25519
child is hardened — so NO xpub can yield an ed25519 child public key,
for anyone, ever. For ed25519 entries the published PUBLIC_KEY is
authoritative and MUST remain present.

A future revision that removes the published ed25519 PUBLIC_KEY would make
every ed25519-signed EPM unverifiable; the retained key is deliberate,
not a transitional leftover.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. An address only — NOT a
derivation path; the derivation path lives in KEY_PATH

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened)

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DOMAIN.description: Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "sdn.spaceaware.io")

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

LEGAL_NAME.description: Common name of the entity (person or organization)

FAMILY_NAME.description: Family name or surname of the person

GIVEN_NAME.description: Given name or first name of the person

ADDITIONAL_NAME.description: Additional name or middle name of the person

HONORIFIC_PREFIX.description: Honorific prefix preceding the person's name (e.g., Mr., Dr.)

HONORIFIC_SUFFIX.description: Honorific suffix following the person's name (e.g., Jr., Sr.)

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE.description:
Signature over canonical EPM content (hex), produced by the entity's
signing key under the algorithm declared in SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM
(absent declaration = Ed25519)

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

PLGFlowNode.description:
One node in a composed flow graph. A degenerate flow IS a module: a leaf
module leaves the flow-graph fields on PLG empty; a composed flow populates
them. This is how flows reuse the module schema rather than a separate one.

NODE_ID.description: Stable node identifier within this flow

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin id of the module this node invokes

METHOD_ID.description: Method id invoked on the module

DISPATCH_MODEL.description:
Dispatch model: empty = linked-direct (in-wasm), "isomorphic" = an
independently instantiated signed WASM node, and "host-capability" = a
generic host adapter.

CONFIG.description: Opaque per-node configuration (FlatBuffer or raw bytes; never JSON)

CANONICAL_TYPE.description:
Canonical SDS identity carried by the edge. NOT `required`: an edge may
be opaque by design (see OPAQUE), and a signer must never be forced to
invent an identity to satisfy the schema. A contract MUST carry exactly
one of CANONICAL_TYPE or OPAQUE = true; a contract with neither, or with
both, is invalid and MUST be rejected by the compiler that signs the flow.

OPAQUE.description:
The edge carries bytes with no SDS identity BY DESIGN — an
application-blind host-capability adapter (an HTTP body, a raw file
chunk) or a timer TICK frame with no payload at all. This is a deliberate
signed assertion of opacity, which is why it is an explicit flag rather
than an absent CANONICAL_TYPE: a missing type must stay distinguishable
from a declared-opaque one. An opaque edge is ineligible for the aligned
route, so ALIGNED_ELIGIBLE MUST be false when OPAQUE is true.

PLGFlowEdge.description: One directed edge wiring a producer output port to a consumer input port.

CONTRACT.description:
Exact identity/layout and compile-time representation policy. NOT
`required`: marking a NEW field of an EXISTING table required makes the
FlatBuffers verifier reject every $PLG buffer written before 1.0.13,
which is a breaking change to a ratified standard. Presence is enforced
where it belongs — the flow compiler MUST refuse to SIGN a flow whose
edges lack a CONTRACT, and a verifier MUST reject a signed flow edge
without one. Buffers predating 1.0.13 stay readable and stay unsigned.

PLGFlowTrigger.description: One flow trigger (e.g. a host timer or HTTP route) that starts a drain.

DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS.description: Default firing interval in milliseconds (timer triggers)

PLGFlowTriggerBinding.description: Binds a trigger to the node + input port it delivers its frame to.

accepted wire formats). ENTRY_FUNCTIONS retains the slim
name+input_schemas+output_schema summary; METHODS carries the full
invoke-surface detail including aligned-binary advertisement.

HOST_CAPABILITIES.description:
Enum-typed host capability dependencies (richer than CAPABILITIES,
which is string-tagged metadata).

SCHEMAS_USED.description: FlatBuffer schemas this plugin depends on at the invoke surface.

BUILD_ARTIFACTS.description: Build artifacts emitted by the toolchain (WASM, bindings, etc.).

ALLOWED_XPUBS.description:
Allowed requester xpub identities (BIP-32 account xpubs) for module grants:
a requester whose verified EPM binds an xpub in this list is granted (PKI
identity authorization). Empty list = no xpub allowlist gate.

FLOW_NODES.description:
Composition graph (a degenerate flow is a module): the nodes this flow
invokes. Empty for a leaf module; populated for a composed flow. The flow
definition is this PLG FlatBuffer, not a bespoke JSON graph.

FLOW_EDGES.description: Composition-graph edges wiring node output ports to input ports.

FLOW_TRIGGERS.description: Flow triggers (timer/http) that start a drain.

FLOW_TRIGGER_BINDINGS.description: Bindings from triggers to the node + input port they deliver to.

PMMTrustAnchor.description:
The single key identity every signature in this manifest resolves to, and
the two external anchors that give that key its weight: the DNS proof that
binds it to the domain, and the Adversarial-Security bond that prices
trust in it.

PROVIDER_DOMAIN.description:
Domain the node key is bound to. MUST equal `PMM.PROVIDER_DOMAIN` and
MUST equal the origin the manifest was fetched from.

NODE_PEER_ID.description: libp2p peer id of the provider node.

NODE_XPUB.description:
BIP-32 account xpub of the node identity, verbatim as advertised in the
node's `$EPM`.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Hex-encoded public key that verifies `PMM.SIGNATURE` and every
`PMMModuleEntry.ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE`, derived from the node key.

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm identifier, e.g. "ed25519",
"secp256k1-compact-ethereum". Empty means "ed25519".

EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the provider node's `$EPM`.

DNS_PROOF_RECORD_NAME.description:
Fully-qualified DNS name of the TXT record carrying the signed
domain-to-nodekey proof, e.g. "_sdnkey.example.org". A verifying client
resolves this itself (DNS-over-HTTPS) rather than trusting the copy
below.

DNS_PROOF_TXT.description:
Verbatim TXT value of that proof, carried only so a client can detect
disagreement with what DNS returns. The resolved record always wins.

DNS_PROOF_STATEMENT.description:
The canonical statement the DNS proof signs, verbatim, when the proof
format keeps it out of the TXT value.

BOND_ADDRESSES.description:
Chain addresses derived from this same node key that hold the provider's
Adversarial-Security bond. Each entry proves, through `ChainProof`, that
the address derives from the key that signed this manifest.

BOND_ATTESTATION_URL.description:
Optional URL of a machine-readable bond attestation (bonded value,
duration unspent) for clients that price trust rather than gate on it.

MODULE_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS module identity, e.g. "com.orbpro.sgp4-propagator". Stable
across versions. Required and unique within the manifest.

PLUGIN_ID.description:
`$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` of the full listing for this module, when one is
published.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the offered artifact.

EPOCH.description:
Monotonic publication counter for this MODULE_ID. Increases on every
re-publication, including a rebuild at the same VERSION.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) WASM bytes. Identical
in meaning to `$APP.APPModuleRef.CONTENT_HASH`: this is the identity
capability and signature policies key on.

ARTIFACT_SIZE_BYTES.description: Size of those portable WASM bytes.

ARTIFACT_PATH.description:
Path, relative to the provider origin, from which the artifact is
fetched. Relative on purpose: the bytes must come from the same origin
whose domain the DNS proof binds.

ARTIFACT_CID.description: IPFS CID of the artifact, for content-addressed retrieval.

ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE.description:
Detached signature by the key in `PMMTrustAnchor.SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY`
over the 32 raw bytes of `CONTENT_HASH`. Lets a client reject an entry
before spending a byte of bandwidth. The artifact's own publication
trailer remains authoritative after download.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. Treated as OPTIONAL by verifiers.

CORE.description: The provider declares this module part of its baseline service. Only a CORE entry may ever be loaded before a user session exists, and only a CORE entry is presented pre-selected at first sign-in.

RECOMMENDED.description: Offered and endorsed by the provider, but never loaded without an explicit user selection.

DEFAULT_ENABLED.description:
True when the provider ships this module enabled by default. A recorded
user choice overrides it permanently.

ACCESS_POLICY.description: What the client must hold to fetch and run it.

ANONYMOUS.description: No session, no grant: an unauthenticated client may fetch and run it.

ENTITLED.description: An entitlement or license grant is required (see `$ENT`, `$PLK`).

DEPRECATED.description: Still served, superseded by another entry. Clients SHOULD migrate.

WITHDRAWN.description: No longer served. Clients MUST NOT fetch it.

REVOKED.description: Actively distrusted by the provider (compromise, bad build). Clients MUST refuse this CONTENT_HASH even if they already hold the bytes.

RUNTIME_TARGETS.description:
Opaque runtime-target tags this artifact is built for, e.g. "browser",
"wasmedge". Same vocabulary as `$PLG.RUNTIME_TARGETS`.

REQUIRED_SCHEMAS.description: SDS schema codes at this module's invoke surface, e.g. "OMM", "OEM".

MIN_PERMISSIONS.description:
Minimum host permissions the module needs, same vocabulary as
`$PLG.MIN_PERMISSIONS`. Surfaced so a client can show what an
anonymously-loaded CORE module is allowed to do.

LICENSE.description: SPDX license identifier of the module.

SUPERSEDES_CONTENT_HASH.description: `CONTENT_HASH` this entry replaces, when it supersedes an earlier build.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) of
the last change to this entry.

PLUGIN_TYPE.description:
Family this module belongs to. Mirrors `$PLG.PLUGIN_TYPE` verbatim and
is the ONLY sanctioned way to group an offering: a client grouping a
catalogue MUST read this field and MUST NOT infer family from the shape
of `MODULE_ID`, which carries no normative structure. Defaults to
`Unspecified`, which a client MUST render as ungrouped — never silently
as `Sensor`. Present here, rather than only on
the linked `$PLG`, so an anonymous client can section the catalogue at
boot without fetching one `$PLG` per module.
